column3: #2649 closed: LocalStorage.CreateOrUpdateSecretACL now runs its upsert and a FOR SHARE re-read of the live secret node in one transaction and rolls back if the node is gone; DeleteSecret UPDATEs (locks) the secret row before its CWE-284 ACL cascade, so the cascade either sees the committed grant or the grant fails closed. #4533 closed (the second variant #2649 names): the IsProjectMember pre-read is not serial-equivalent against RemoveProjectMember, so the same transaction takes FOR SHARE on the grantee's live direct user_roles rows at the node's project (lockDirectProjectGrants) BEFORE the upsert and re-asks the membership question (isProjectMemberOn) after it, refusing with storage.ErrSecretACLGranteeNotMember; RemoveAllProjectRoleGrants DELETEs (locks) those rows before ClearProjectSecretOwnership and DeleteSecretACLsByUserAndProject, so either the removal waits and its cascade sweeps the committed grant or the grant waits and fails closed, and both lock user_roles first, so a re-grant or a grant to the owner cannot deadlock the removal (REVIEW-4557-DEEP-1 MEDIUM-1). Not covered: a group-only member (RemoveProjectMember refuses them as not a member; a group-membership removal has no ACL cascade, a separate gap).
